latestIgtvVideos.title: Cleaning With Aqueous Ozone 🤔🦠
latestIgtvVideos.caption:
I recently purchased a spray bottle that promises to kill 99.9% of common household bacteria in 30 seconds 🙋‍♀️👌. So, of course, I had to put that to the test because as much as I want that to be true, it sounds a little *too good to be true* 🧐. Armed with some agar plates 🧫 and a healthy dose of curiosity, I tested some common surfaces #beforeandafter to see how well it performed. **BTW, This video is 💯% NON-SPONSORED.** 
.
.
I swabbed the surfaces before cleaning, and then used the spray bottle, which generates #aqueousozone on demand, waited 30 seconds, and wiped. I swabbed the clean surfaces, and transferred those samples to the agar plates. This video shows my results 3 days later. 🤗

Aqueous ozone works as a powerful sanitizer, deodorizer, and cleaner - all you need is tap water and electricity. **No cartridges or capsules**. After it’s done kicking some serious bacteria booty, it converts back into water and oxygen, making it a safe, non-toxic cleaning solution for any household. 
.
Aqueous ozone also isn’t NEW. Ozone water treatment has been used commercially since 1904, and is still used today. But, the proof is in the pudding, so I put this video together showing how well it worked in our house 👏. 
This cleaner has also been shown to demonstrate greater than 99.9% inactivation of Human Coronavirus 
229E/ATCC VR-740, a commercially available surrogate virus for the Human Coronavirus SARS-Cov-2 which causes the COVID-19 Disease within 30 seconds 🦠 🙌
Full review: SLAYathomemother.com/cleaning-with-ozonated-water
Spray bottle: @o3waterworks

A new season is coming our way, mamas - and we’re mentally prepping for that shift.

New school schedules, sports, dinner menus, laundry demands, work obligations, less daylight 😆.

Even the most prepared person can get overwhelmed by so many changes, especially after the beautiful bliss of summertime, sunshine, and flexibility 🥰🫶🥹

I have to remind myself at the start of every season that I don’t have to have it all together, not everything has to get checked off my list, and I’m doing JUST FINE 😅🤘.

But if you’re needing some of these Home Reset Rules, too, they really help bring things back to perspective and keep you from burning out. Here they are again! 

My Home Reset Rules:

One room at a time.
Timer first.
Done beats perfect.
Every item needs a home.
Stop before burnout.

Save this post and share some of your reset rules with me below! 👇🩷✨

#tidyspacetidymind #cleaning #cleanhome #cleanwithmemotivation #roomreset

Pulled pork mini sandwiches for the win! Comment RECIPE 👇👇👇 and I’ll send you this one to copy/paste or screenshot 🥰

This is one of my favorite low effort family dinner meal ideas because the crockpot basically does all the work for me. No special prep, thawing, for forethought going into this one. We make this any season, and pair it with whatever we’re feeling like that day! 

Here’s what you need:
- half loin roast pork
- 2 lemons 🍋 
- seasoning of your choice 
- BBQ sauce 
- Hawaiian rolls 
- crockpot 

Don’t forgot to repurpose your lemon slices in a measuring cup or bowl of 2 cups of water and heat on HIGH for 5 minutes to help deep clean your microwave 😉 be careful as the water will be SUPER HOT. 🥵 

What’s your favorite low-effort family meal? 😍👇👇👇

I made my own custom car emblem using acrylic, my laser, and some 3M tape. 

This is my third time making one for our cars, and they stay put through car washes, rain, wind, hail 😆, wildfire smoke, all the Midwest adventures we go on, you name it. My husband’s has been on his car for two years now, my previous car had one on for 2.5 years, now it was time for decorate my new car :). 

 They hold up great and are so fun to make! 

Laser: @thunderlaserusa Nova Plus [thunderlaserpartner]
Material: 2 layers of 1/8” acrylic + double-sided 3M tape 

Be sure to clean your flat surface really well and apply pressure for a couple minutes. I would also avoid washing directly/rain for about 48 hours 😉 if that wasn’t obvious! 🫶

Comment “TUBS” and I’ll send you the 🔗👇👇👇 

What a lot of organizers won’t tell you is that you don’t have to make your space fit the containers - you should make the containers fit YOUR space. If you even need them 🤷‍♀️ 

In this case - I definitely did 😆🫣 but my old setup wasn’t working (it wasn’t the giant stack shown in this video, but it wasn’t working, so I ditched the system I was using for the giant stack 😁). 

And that’s the cycle…

Try one system —> 
realize it doesn’t fit your needs so you ditch it —> 
end up with a giant stack or pile —> 
figure out something that actually DOES work for your space and needs. 🫰 

I knew I wanted four containers, preferably different colors (for easy sorting and organizing for both me and the kids) and I needed them much wider than the 2” vertical containers I was using. 

Those would be able to hold one, maybe two books - nothing more 😕

This works so much better for us, and while it might not be as beige or clear as someone else’s homeschool setup - it works 👏. And that’s the real goal in home organization, am I right? 

Skip what everyone else thinks would or should work. Measure your workbooks (or items!) and find containers that fit around the measurements you need. 

#homeorganizer #organized #homeschool #homeschoolroom #organizedhouse
